Here are the two highest-rated attractions in Sydney for your family trip, along with detailed information:

1. Behind The Scenes: Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) Guided Walking Tour
- Description: This 90-minute guided walking tour takes you behind the scenes of the iconic Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) precinct and the SCG Museum. It's a dynamic experience for locals, international visitors, and sports fans of all ages. You'll tread the Path of Champions, learn about the history of the ground, and see exclusive areas.
- Language: English
- Duration: 90 minutes
- Price: $22.11 USD per person
- Free Cancellation: Yes
- What’s Included: Professional guide, behind-the-scenes walking tour
- Not Included: Transportation to/from the attraction
- Accessibility: Wheelchair access available on approximately 90% of the tour

- Reviews: Average rating 4.9/5 (69 reviews). Guests praise the knowledgeable guides and the unique access to the stadium.
- Example Review: “Really interesting and a few surprises on the tour. Our guide was funny, informed, and delivered her information very well. Highly recommended for cricket fans!” – Patricia, Australia

- Description: This all-in-one pass allows you to visit some of Sydney’s top attractions, including the Sydney Opera House, SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium, Sydney Harbour Bridge, WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo, Darling Harbour, Bondi Beach, and Sydney Tower Eye. - Free Cancellation: Yes

- Additional Info: You must bring your ticket to each attraction. The pass can be used within 30 days from your first visit.
